subject: Resilience retainer & deploy-credit term clarifications
messages:
From: Elena Morales <em@brightgrid.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@brightgrid.io>
Date: 2027-08-28T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: Quick clarifications on retainer + deployment credits

Kimberly —

Thanks for the draft term sheet. BrightGrid is generally aligned but we need a couple of clarifications before we route to procurement: 

- Does the proposed retainer cover 24/7 escalation for P1s globally, or is APAC treated as an add-on? We have a distributed ops team and want consistent coverage.
- How and when are "deployment credits" applied to invoices? We expect a pilot deployment in month 1 and need to understand if pilot credits are deducted from the first invoice or applied as a future credit.
- Can credits roll forward if unused? If so, for how long?

A few folks on our side (Contracts) will need explicit language on these points. Also attaching the procurement checklist we use (see inline reference).

Would you be able to confirm by EOD Wednesday so we can schedule a short legal sync?

Thanks —
Elena Morales
Head of Platform Partnerships
BrightGrid

Attachments: BrightGrid_Procurement_Checklist.pdf (referenced)

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <em@brightgrid.io>
Cc: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>, Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-29T10:05:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on retainer + deployment credits

Elena —

Appreciate the fast read. Summary answers below and I've attached an updated term sheet + a simple spreadsheet that demonstrates how deployment credits flow across invoices. See attachments: SLA_Retainer_Termsheet_v3.pdf and deployment_credit_calc.xlsx.

High level: 
- Coverage: The retainer we proposed includes 24/7 escalation coverage for Priority 1 incidents across NA/EU by default. APAC coverage is available as a paid add-on. For this deal, given your global footprint, we can include APAC escalation as part of a 12-month pilot at no additional retainer for the first 90 days (after which standard regional surcharge would apply unless we agree otherwise).

- Deployment credits: Pilot deployment credits are applied as a credit on the first invoice following go-live. Example in the spreadsheet: a $50k pilot credit reduces Invoice #1 charges; any residual credit rolls forward to reduce subsequent invoices until exhausted.

- Rollforward: Credits can roll forward for up to one quarter (90 days) by default. If you need longer (we've seen asks up to 12 months), we can accommodate with an explicit commitment level — Karthik, see note below on tiered rollforward.

Open points I flagged for legal: explicit clause language on the pilot-credit trigger (needs to be tied to a signed go-live checklist) and a cap on monthly credit usage to avoid large one-time offsets.

Proposed next steps: 
1) Review attached sheet and confirm the pilot credit amount you expect.
2) If OK, schedule a 30-minute legal sync Thursday to finalize clause language.

Thanks —
Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference

Attachments: SLA_Retainer_Termsheet_v3.pdf, deployment_credit_calc.xlsx

From: Elena Morales <em@brightgrid.io>
To: Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Contracts Team <contracts@brightgrid.io>
Date: 2027-08-30T08:23:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on retainer + deployment credits

Kimberly —

Thanks for the detail and the spreadsheet. A couple of follow-ups from Contracts and Finance: 

- Rollforward: 90 days is okay for the pilot but Contracts is asking whether we can extend rollforward to 12 months for any credits tied to platform migrations (major initiatives). It helps us avoid re-budgeting mid-year.

- Cap on monthly credit usage: We understand the need for a cap. Can you propose a numeric cap (either % of monthly committed spend or a dollar limit)? That will make it easier for our FP&A to model costs.

- APAC pilot: Appreciate the 90-day inclusion. Can we capture that as "APAC regional escalation included for the initial 90 days of the contract, after which regional surcharge applies unless otherwise agreed"? Contracts prefers explicit start/end triggers.

We can do the legal sync Thursday if you can share the updated clause language ahead of time.

Best —
Elena

From: Karthik Iyer <karthik@redwood.com>
To: Elena Morales <em@brightgrid.io>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.com>
Cc: Jonas Weber <jonas@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-08-31T11:40:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on retainer + deployment credits

Elena / all —

Adding a bit more color on the mechanics and a concrete cap suggestion to speed procurement modeling. See inline on the spreadsheet (deployment_credit_calc.xlsx) but summarizing here: 

- Suggested cap: monthly credit application capped at 25% of the monthly committed usage (commit = agreed monthly buffer of reserved capacity / minimum monthly spend). This prevents a large one-off credit wiping out run-rate economics while still giving BrightGrid meaningful relief during ramp.

- Rollforward tiers: 
  * Pilot credits (one-off migration or POC) — up to 12 months rollforward if deal includes a 12-month committed spend floor (we can make this explicit in Section 2.3).
  * Standard monthly credits (operational credits for small maintenance windows) — 90 days rollforward.

- APAC: We can capture the 90-day inclusion as Kimberly suggested. Operationally, the 90-day starter period will be triggered by the first production go-live sign-off (signed by BrightGrid Eng and Redwood CSM). We propose the clause: 

  "APAC regional escalation is included at no additional retainer for the first ninety (90) days from the production go-live sign-off. Thereafter, regional surcharge rates specified in Schedule B apply unless otherwise agreed in writing."

- Pilot credit trigger: tie to a signed 'go-live checklist' held in the shared Drive (link posted in HubSpot) so both sides have a single point of truth.

If that sounds good, I can draft the clause language we talked about and circulate to Contracts.

Thanks —
Karthik Iyer
Director, Deal Structuring
Redwood Inference

Date: 2027-09-01T17:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Quick clarifications on retainer + deployment credits

Elena / Contracts —

Thanks for the quick back-and-forth. To capture the outcome and unblock legal: 

Agreed summary (to be reflected in final terms):
- Coverage: Retainer includes 24/7 P1 escalation for NA/EU. APAC regional escalation is included at no additional charge for the first 90 days following production go-live sign-off; Schedule B regional surcharge language applies after the starter period.
- Deployment credits: Pilot credits are applied to the first invoice after production go-live sign-off. Any unused pilot credits will roll forward.
- Rollforward policy: Pilot/migration credits — up to 12 months rollforward only if BrightGrid signs a 12-month committed-spend minimum (per Deal BG-2027-432). Otherwise, pilot credits roll forward for up to 90 days.
- Monthly cap: Deployment credits applied to any monthly invoice will be capped at 25% of that month’s committed usage.
- Triggers: Pilot credit and APAC starter period are triggered by a mutually signed go-live checklist (stored in the linked HubSpot drive).

Next steps: 
1) I will ask Legal to insert the clause language Karthik proposed into SLA_Retainer_Termsheet_v3 and circulate a redline.
2) Elena / Contracts — please confirm you accept the above summary (reply-all). If accepted, we'll set the 30-minute legal sync for Thursday 09/02 11:00 AM PT (invite to follow).

If there's any new objection, flag it in your reply and we'll address it in the sync.

Best regards,

Kimberly Park
Head of Strategic Deals
Redwood Inference
